in_arabic.name: أرّا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث، يعني المرأة الحميدة أو ذات الخُلُق الحسن

in_english.name: Arra
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arra originates from Arabic roots, specifically derived from the term 'rāʿ' which connotes tranquility or good nature. In Islamic tradition, the name Arra signifies a woman with excellent character and morals. Historically, names with such positive connotations were chosen to reflect desirable personality traits. The name Arra, therefore, symbolizes a woman of piety, kindness, and good conduct.
